# Tender response -- JHVA-2026-TEK-014

Visakoivu Oy -- technical and property maintenance framework agreement

## About Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company active in LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance, and is also certified to NMSB 73710 for information security, relevant to the reporting and automation elements of this framework.

## Technical response (Section 4)

4.1 Scheduled HVAC visits follow a fixed annual calendar covering all five properties, logged on the day of each visit, with a summary report provided to the Buyer's technical contact.

4.5 An occupational safety plan covering work in and around active patient-care areas is enclosed with this response, prepared for the specific conditions of occupied health premises.

4.8 Completed maintenance and repair work is checked under our internal quality control procedures before sign-off to the Buyer, with a written record kept on file.

4.10 Energy-efficiency measures proposed during the contract period include scheduling optimisation, controls tuning, and periodic review of the maintained systems' running hours.

4.11 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a scheduled basis appropriate to each system type, with test records retained.

4.12 Continuity of service is maintained through cross-trained cover and handover documentation if key maintenance personnel leave or are reassigned during the contract period.

4.13 Proposed service level targets are tiered by fault category, from safety-critical faults through to routine requests, with monthly reporting against target.

4.14 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed across all properties covered by this framework, on the applicable statutory cycle.

4.15 Commissioning and testing follow a written protocol applied after any equipment replacement or major repair, witnessed before handover.

4.16 Refrigeration and cooling equipment on site is maintained under our F-gas qualification, with logged leak checks at statutory intervals.

## Commercial terms (Section 5)

5.1 Limitation of liability is as set out in our standard terms, available on request from our commercial contact.

5.2 A discount structure is proposed, scaling with call-off volume as it increases over the contract period, reviewed annually.

5.3 Prices are quoted in euro throughout this response, consistent with the framework's reference currency.

5.4 Pricing distinguishes fixed-price maintenance visits, unit-priced parts and materials, and time-based charging for call-out work outside scheduled visits.

## Forms enclosed (Section 6)

Reference form (Liite 2), completed and enclosed; certificate of tax payment, dated within the required period.

## Format (Section 7)

7.1 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, as required.

7.3 All monetary figures in this response are rounded to two decimal places.

7.5 The closing time of 6 November 2026, 14:00 Finnish time, is noted.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 A method statement is provided describing how installation and replacement works will be carried out in occupied buildings, minimising disruption to care operations.

3.1 A preventive maintenance plan covers all system categories listed in this annex, with proposed inspection intervals for each.

7.1 Our on-call arrangement, described above, extends to round-the-clock cover within Finland.

## Liite B -- Kaupalliset ehdot

B.1 A bonus-malus arrangement is proposed against agreed service level targets, with any bonus or penalty calculated against the affected call-off value.

B.3 The payment term applicable under this annex is 14 days net.

Visakoivu Oy
